annotations.title: Pause or resume a webhook trigger

description: Pause or resume one of your webhook triggers. A paused hook keeps its URL but                  every post to it is refused until resumed. Requires a logged-in identity.

hook_id.description: UUID of the webhook trigger to pause or resume.

paused.description: true to pause, false to resume.
